tips.text: Unlock Vox Solaris rank 1 first; its toroid and standing grind overlaps with later Vox gear.
Farm the Alloy Plate in the background, then pick up the Cryotic and Argon on the day you build.
Players rate the Plinx far above its looks; the grumbling is about Vox Solaris and Gyromags, not the build.
